analysis:
The supplied units are base_text excerpts (lines 1217-2025) of docs/architecture/inference.md. The PR changes only documentation: the date stamp, a clause at about line 3635 exempting Gemma 4 from the tensor-parallel preference via ClusterTensorParallelChoice.fastest, and a new Gemma 4 tensor-parallel foundation section at about lines 4037-4240 in the head. The base excerpts I reviewed do not contain the changed ranges. The patch excerpt is truncated and incomplete, so I could not review the new Gemma 4 tensor-parallel section's content.

The base text covers GLM native media, prefix and prompt caches, deadlines, MTP and calibration. No security-relevant behavior changes in the visible portion. The cache and TTFT-oracle notes remain consistent with T-041 and SEC-035. The ChunkBatcher sink-check text matches T-008 and TB-002 and is unchanged.

Open question for the next pass: the new section describes Gemma 4 tensor-parallel placement across two Macs and a rename of the Qwen35TensorParallelSwitchLinear file to TensorParallelSwitchLinear. If the head describes or implements inter-Mac transport, then the trust boundary for peer-to-peer activation traffic, which carries decrypted prompt-derived tensors, needs checking against A-001, TB-003 and TB-007. The supplied evidence does not show that. This is a documentation-only change with no visible security regression, and no finding is raised, but the unseen head content in lines 4037-4240 is the remaining gap.
